sub_category.description: Product sub-category from the valid options list

sub_category_detail.description: Short Korean item type label without brand or color (e.g., 봄버 재킷, 트렌치코트, 크루넥 스웨트셔츠)

fit.description: One of: slim, regular, relaxed, oversized. Omit when not applicable or not visible

material.description: Short Korean material labels, deduplicated, usually 1-3 items (e.g., 코튼, 린넨 혼방, 스웨이드)

style.description: Style tags from the exact allowed taxonomy only (e.g., workwear, vintage, military)

pattern.description: Pattern type in English (e.g., solid, stripe, check, camo, print)

details.description: 2-5 short Korean construction or silhouette details, excluding color and material repetition

description_ko.description: Short Korean semantic summary in 1-2 sentences. Complements structured fields instead of enumerating them. Avoid starting with the brand name. Factual, compact, no marketing fluff
